options.content:
### 這個 dashboard 看什麼、不看什麼

**看**：最近幾小時 crawler 的即時細節（哪支在抓、抓哪裡、拿到什麼狀態碼、拉走多大的內容）。

**不看長期趨勢**——Loki 的 retention 只有 **168h（7 天）**，再往前查會回 HTTP 200 + 全零、
不報錯，看起來跟「那時候沒有 crawler」一模一樣。長期趨勢請查 Supabase 的 `crawl_daily`
（由 `scripts/ingest_crawl_hourly.py` 每小時落庫，資料不隨 Loki 過期）。

**預設時間範圍刻意只有 3 小時。** 這條 stream 單小時約 15 萬行 / 113MB，
而 Grafana 走的 proxy 有 **約 30 秒的 wall clock 上限**（超過回 HTTP 502，不是 Loki 的門檻）。
實測：3h 約 14.5s、6h 就會逼近上限。拉長時間範圍前先有心理準備。

**這裡的 GSC 看不到**：Search Console API 沒有 Crawl Stats resource，
而且 GSC 的檢索統計**只涵蓋 Googlebot**。實測 AI crawler 佔本站 crawler 流量的一半以上，
那一整塊只有這裡與 `crawl_daily` 看得到。

panels.title: Crawler 請求數（依 bot 分群）
panels.description: token 為空的序列 = UA 含 bot/crawler/spider/slurp 但不屬任何具名 crawler，對應 crawl_daily 的 other-bot 桶。

panels.title: Crawler vs 全站請求數
panels.description: 兩條線的比值就是 crawl budget 佔比。實測 2026-09-01 約 5.2%。

panels.title: 狀態碼分佈（依 bot 分群，最近 1 小時）
panels.description: crawler 拿到 4xx/5xx 代表 crawl budget 被浪費在打不開的頁上。

panels.title: 抓取路徑分佈（依 bot 分群，最近 1 小時）
panels.description: pfx 為空 = 不在 allowlist 的第一層路徑（多數是掛在根路徑的使用者頁），對應 crawl_daily 的 /__other__ 殘餘桶。

targets.expr: sum by (token, pfx) (count_over_time({job="loki.source.kubernetes.envoy_proxy"} | json | user_agent =~ `.*(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot|[Bb]ot|[Cc]rawler|[Ss]pider|[Ss]lurp).*` | label_format token=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot).*$|^.*$" .user_agent "${1}" }}`, pfx=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^(/(?:article|salon|tags|user|post|search|api|_next|static|not-found|robots[.]txt|sitemap[.]xml|feed|rss|pay|become_creator|[.]well-known|favicon[.]ico)?)(?:[/?#].*)?$|^.*$" .path "${1}" }}` [1h]))

panels.title: crawler 4xx/5xx 請求數
panels.description: 狀態碼是 json 解出來的欄位，這裡用 label filter 比較數值。

targets.expr: sum by (token) (count_over_time({job="loki.source.kubernetes.envoy_proxy"} | json | user_agent =~ `.*(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot|[Bb]ot|[Cc]rawler|[Ss]pider|[Ss]lurp).*` | status >= 400 | label_format token=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot).*$|^.*$" .user_agent "${1}" }}` [$__interval]))

panels.title: 送出位元組（bytes_sent，依 bot 分群）
panels.description: 實際送出的 wire bytes，與 crawl_daily 的 bytes 欄同一個定義。

targets.expr: sum by (token) (sum_over_time({job="loki.source.kubernetes.envoy_proxy"} | json | user_agent =~ `.*(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot|[Bb]ot|[Cc]rawler|[Ss]pider|[Ss]lurp).*` | label_format token=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot).*$|^.*$" .user_agent "${1}" }}` | unwrap bytes_sent [$__interval]))

panels.title: origin_content_length p95（依 bot 分群）
panels.description: 原站回應的內容大小（未壓縮），回答「crawler 每次拉走多大的內容」。⚠ 這一欄只在 status 200 的行有值，3xx/4xx 是 null 會被 unwrap 丟掉——所以它是「成功抓到的內容有多大」，不是「傳輸成本」。傳輸成本看上面的 bytes_sent。正因為這個 null 行為，crawl_daily 的 bytes 欄存的是 bytes_sent 而不是這一欄。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="loki.source.kubernetes.envoy_proxy"} | json | user_agent =~ `.*(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot|[Bb]ot|[Cc]rawler|[Ss]pider|[Ss]lurp).*` | label_format token=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*?(Googlebot-Image|Googlebot-Video|Googlebot-News|AdsBot-Google-Mobile|AdsBot-Google|Google-AMPHTML|Google-InspectionTool|Google-Safety|GoogleOther|Googlebot|bingbot|Claude-SearchBot|Claude-User|OAI-SearchBot|ChatGPT-User|PerplexityBot|YouBot|ExaSearchBot|ClaudeBot|GPTBot|Bytespider|meta-webindexer|AIWebIndex|Amazonbot|Applebot|AhrefsSiteAudit|AhrefsBot|SemrushBot|DataForSeoBot|SERankingBacklinksBot|facebookexternalhit|meta-externalads|Dcard-link-preview-bot|YandexBot|Baiduspider|DuckDuckBot|PetalBot).*$|^.*$" .user_agent "${1}" }}` | unwrap origin_content_length [$__interval]) by (token)
